import math


def largest_triangle(a, b):
    """Write a function to find the largest triangle that can be inscribed in an ellipse.

    The largest triangle inscribed in a unit circle is equilateral, with
    area ``3 * sqrt(3) / 4``. Scaling the circle by ``a`` in one direction
    and ``b`` in the perpendicular direction produces the ellipse with
    semi-axes ``a`` and ``b`` and multiplies all areas by ``a * b``, so the
    largest inscribed triangle in the ellipse has area
    ``(3 * sqrt(3) / 4) * a * b``.
    """
    return (3 * math.sqrt(3) / 4) * a * b
